a.lede: Politicians on both sides of the aisle seem angry, agitated, and nonplussed by the return of Jensen Huang to Nvidia leadership less than two weeks after his ousting.
a.title: ‘Outrageous,’ ‘reckless,’ ‘wow’: Here’s what politicians are saying about Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia

b.lede: The president cited the U.S. attorney general in defending Huang's return, while urging Nvidia to continue its export-control investigation.
b.title: Trump endorses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, says US has no evidence of wrongdoing
